title: Separate eligibility from release, reward distribution from market buying, and stablecoin rails from XRP demand
context: Recent research found a scheduled 1B XRP escrow eligibility event, new SBI retail/business reward channels, a direct Ripple-Coinbase RLUSD partnership, Circle/ACI USDC settlement, Coinbase-contributed x402 with a third-party XRPL facilitator, and conflicting market-data scopes.
Current repository main contains active write-capable workflows, while fresh-main safety and prediction-integrity PRs have passed exact-head CI but remain unmerged.
decisions: Represent escrow lifecycle as ELIGIBLE, FINISHED, RE-ESCROWED, TRANSFERRED_TO_EXCHANGE and SOLD; never equate FinishAfter with circulating supply or market sale.

Represent XRP reward products as POINTS_ISSUED, POINTS_REDEEMED, XRP_CREDITED, INVENTORY_SOURCE_IDENTIFIED and MARKET_PURCHASE_VERIFIED; only the last state can be considered direct spot-buy evidence.

Represent stablecoin relationships by issuer, chain, listing, custody, conversion, collateral and actual settlement volume. A listing or future collateral announcement is not a current collateral balance.

Treat Coinbase-Ripple RLUSD as a direct distribution partnership, but retain Circle-USDC distribution economics as a separate material relationship; measure actual issuer mix before claiming substitution.

Treat x402 as a vendor-neutral protocol contributed by Coinbase to the Linux Foundation; treat T54's XRPL facilitator as a separate implementation. Reconcile on-chain transaction fingerprints and settled value before using volume counts.
Use category-specific asOf and basis metadata for XRP supply exports; never apply the oldest top-level timestamp to every category.

Keep exchange wallet balances separate by provider and wallet universe; include non-customer reserve components and customer pooled custody, and do not equate balances with tradable float or official PoR.
Keep ETF flow and derivatives observations provider-specific; provisional fund rows and different contract universes are not averaged.

Do not admit new SBI, escrow, RLUSD, x402, ETF, exchange-wallet or derivatives metrics into the predictive feature store until provenance, timestamp, scope, independence and point-in-time availability are validated.
Do not issue a directional forecast. PR #1414 is a forecast/outcome ledger foundation, not a trained model or calibrated walk-forward predictor.
Preserve main. PR #1413 and #1414 remain open draft proposals; no merge or external workflow dispatch without approval.
rejected_inferences: 1B XRP will automatically enter circulation or be sold on November 1.
SBI card reward points represent direct XRP market purchases or large net capital.
Circle/ACI USDC settlement proves an XRP integration or displacement.
Coinbase Global Exchange already accepts RLUSD as collateral.
Coinbase operates the T54 XRPL x402 facilitator.
14.77M x402 volume is independently verified market-wide settlement count.
Binance has replenished exactly 233.46M XRP because aggregate exchange balances are similar in size.
ETF cumulative net inflows equal current XRP holdings or net external capital.
Different OI provider totals can be averaged into a market-wide value.
PR-head CI passing means the proposed fixes are active on main.
consequences: More precise capital-flow accounting and fewer false bullish reserve signals.
Additional research work required to reconcile x402 cumulative counters, provider-specific OI and exchange wallet histories.
Prediction engine remains intentionally unforecasting until its out-of-sample gates are implemented.
next_review: After 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC escrow eligibility and Binance's 2026-11-01 05:33 UTC withdrawal target.
